name: lumina-photo
description: Lumina Photo — Cross-platform local photo & video album for 100k+ media with LAN sharing and fast organization

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server exec -- tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix web exec -- tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:web
